title: Quarterly pulse: how is work going? 4 anonymous minutes
description: A short, anonymous quarterly check-in for everyone at {company}.
audience: Everyone employed at {company} (about 120 people) during this quarter
purpose: Decide which two engagement drivers HR acts on this quarter

welcome.title: How is work going?

thank_you.title: Thank you for your honesty
thank_you.description: We'll share the results and the two areas we'll act on at the all-hands on {date}, and report back on progress next quarter. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: How likely are you to recommend {company} as a place to work to a friend or colleague?
What is the main reason for your score?
Compared with three months ago, how is working at {company} for you now?
options: I joined less than three months ago

questions.label: Next: what shapes your work day to day
Thinking about the last three months, how much do you agree or disagree with each statement?
rows: I understand how my work contributes to {company}'s goals
My manager gives me useful feedback
I have the tools I need to do my job well
I can see a path to grow my career here
I am recognised when I do good work
I can raise concerns without fear of negative consequences

questions.label: Which two of these would you most like us to work on this quarter? Choose up to two.
What one change would make the biggest difference to your work this quarter?
Which area do you work in?
questions.description: So we can see where action is needed. We never report a group with fewer than 5 answers.
